options.label: A
options.text: Decreased employment opportunities for minorities and women

options.label: B
options.text: Increased availability of foreign laborers in the United States

options.label: C
options.text: Increased access to foreign markets for U.S. businesses

options.label: D
options.text: Decreased funding for the establishment of national parks
